Talent0_2Ability.name: Strategic Planning
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: At the start of battle and at the start of action, applies <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> to <color=#F74848>1</color> furthest ally not carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> for <color=#F74848>3</color> turns. Up to <color=#F74848>3</color> allies can carry <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf>.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Strategic Planning
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
At the start of battle and at the start of action, applies <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> to <color=#F74848>1</color> furthest ally not carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> for <color=#F74848>3</color> turns. Up to <color=#F74848>3</color> allies can carry <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf>.
For each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf>, DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>7.5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>22.5%</color>.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

401102.name: Teamwork
401102.SpecificEffects: Allies carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> have DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>5%</color> and DMG taken reduces by <color=#F74848>5%</color>.

401103.name: Respite
401103.describe: Fully reload cutter ammo and grants self and allies carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> <buf ID=7100104>[Hit rate UP II]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. Can continue to act with remaining movement.

401104.name: Official Position
401104.describe: Consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> cutter ammo, selects <color=#F74848>1</color> ally within range and applies <buf ID=4011043>[Subtask - Defense]</buf> or <buf ID=4011041>[Subtask - Attack]</buf> to that target.

401105.name: Helping Hand
401105.SpecificEffects: When an ally carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> is attacked, uses <color=#F74848>2</color> cutters to launch <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>2×0.5</color> DMG. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401106.name: Delayed Response
401106.describe: Uses cutter to attack an enemy, dealing <color=#F74848>4×0.6</color> DMG and applies <buf ID=4011061>[Clean Up]</buf> to the target.

401107.name: Mental Support
401107.SpecificEffects: When any part suffers overdamage, if there are allies carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf>, triggers <buf ID=900003>[Guts]</buf>, locking HP at <color=#F74848>1</color>. Upon triggering, consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> from an ally.

401108.name: Restriction Order
401108.describe: Consumes <color=#F74848>2</color> cutter ammo, attacks all enemies within a <range type=2>3-tile radius</range> area, dealing <color=#F74848>1.6x</color> AoE DMG, and applies <terrian ID=4011081 /> to the targeted tiles, lasting for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

401141.name: Firm decision 1
401141.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, AP cost of attack skills or <skill mainSkill=401104>[Official Position]</skill> reduces by <color=#F74848>-1</color>, to a minimum of <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401144.name: Firm decision 2
401144.SpecificEffects: When any ally carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> breaks a part, [Collin] recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> cutter ammo. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401145.name: Firm decision 3
401145.SpecificEffects: When any ally carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf> destroys a target, [Collin] recovers <color=#F74848>1</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401146.name: Firm decision 4
401146.SpecificEffects: For each <color=#F74848>1</color> ally carrying <buf ID=4011502>[Appointment]</buf>, cutter hit count increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>, up to a maximum of <color=#F74848>+3</color>.
